name: cloudflare
description: One tiny Worker + D1 = real view counts with countries, unique visitors, devices, referrers and a 14-day trend. Visitor country comes free from Cloudflare (`request.cf.country`) — no IP API. No raw IP is stored; unique visitors use a salted daily hash (set a secret for better hashing: `npx wrangler secret put SALT`). Bots are filtered out automatically.
